bias_targets.methodology: Application of a transfeminist theoretical lens and a critical self-reflexivity methodology (the 4Rs) to retroactively reinterpret empirical AI governance studies, evaluating how governance frameworks systematically fail to protect transgender and gender-diverse communities from exclusionary norms and AI-driven harms.

Content analysis of 84 Canadian AI governance initiatives and semi-structured interviews with 20 government leaders to evaluate power imbalances, identifying how AI governance systems structurally prioritize industry and economic interests over the needs of marginalized communities and civil society.
